# Second Screen

Design tokens, themes, digital assets, documentation, and schema registry platform built around DTCG 2025.10 standards.

## Endpoints & Docs

- [Documentation](/docs): Public design system documentation and token guidelines.
- [JSON Schema Registry](/api/v1/schemas): Self-hosted Draft 2020-12 DTCG token, color space, and function schemas.
- [Tokens API](/api/v1/tokens): Programmatic token reading and theme resolution endpoint.
- [Releases API](/api/v1/releases): Release packages and distribution outputs.
- [MCP Server](/api/v1/mcp): Model Context Protocol HTTP transport for authenticated design system inspection.
